crossRefs.note: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said…
Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying, yet he didn’t enter in.
The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
translations.bsb: So they took the body of Jesus and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the Jewish burial custom.
translations.kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
translations.asv: So they took the body of Jesus, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
